html-01.title: HTML Module 1 Quiz
html-01.description: Test your understanding of basic HTML tags and structure.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of HTML?
options: To style the appearance of a webpage
To structure the content of a webpage
To store data in a database
questions.explanation: HTML is used to structure webpage content such as headings, paragraphs, links, images, and other elements.

questions.question: Which HTML tag is used for the main heading of a webpage?
questions.explanation: The <h1> element represents the highest-level heading in the HTML document.

questions.question: Which tag is used to create a paragraph in HTML?
questions.explanation:
The

element is used to define a paragraph.

questions.question: Which HTML element is used to create a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The <a> element creates a hyperlink. Its href attribute specifies the destination URL.

questions.question: Which HTML element is commonly used to display an image?
questions.explanation: The element is used to embed an image in an HTML document.

html-02.title: HTML Module 2 Quiz
html-02.description: Test your understanding of HTML forms and data validation.

questions.question: Which HTML element is used to create a form?
questions.explanation: The <form> element defines a section used to collect and submit user input.

questions.question: Which attribute makes an input field required before a form can be submitted?
questions.explanation: The required attribute tells the browser that the user must provide a value before submitting the form.

questions.question: Which input type is most appropriate for collecting an email address?
questions.explanation: type="email" is designed for email addresses and allows the browser to perform basic email-format validation.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the <label> element?
options: To describe or identify a form control
questions.explanation: The <label> element provides a text label for a form control and improves usability and accessibility.

questions.question: Which attribute can be used to limit the number of characters entered into a text input?
questions.explanation: The maxlength attribute specifies the maximum number of characters that the user can enter.
